title_en: A Hundred Birds Pay Homage to the Phoenix
full_text_zh:
[P1] 童读·中华经典神话故事
百鸟朝凤
毛红艳/改编 陈伟工作室/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P2] 中华经典神话故事绘本
百鸟朝凤
毛红艳/改编  陈伟工作室/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P3] “这条小鱼干儿我要带上，它是最香的！”
“这片大树叶我要带上，晚上盖它最暖和。”
“这个果子我要带上，它是我最爱吃的。”
小雁正在收拾去朝见凤凰要带的行李。

[P4] 大雁妈妈笑着问他：“这丛芦苇要不要带上？”
“这丛芦苇开的花比我的羽毛还白，还轻，还软，当然要带上！”小雁眼睛亮闪闪地说，“去年大旱，树和草都干死了，鸟儿们饿得没有力气飞，是凤凰打开自己的山洞，把果子和草籽分给了大家吃。这丛芦苇就是用你珍藏的一颗草籽种出来的，朝见凤凰怎么能不带？”
大雁妈妈拍了拍小雁的翅膀说：“孩子，芦苇不用带，朝见凤凰，我们只需要带上一颗感恩的心！”

[P5] 第二天，小雁和妈妈跟着雁群，
向凤凰居住的丹穴山飞去。
晚上，他们歇在一片松树林里。
松树林里住着三十只黄雀。

[P6] 小黄雀好奇地问小雁：“嗨，
你们要到哪里去？”
小雁回答说：“我们要去朝见
凤凰。”

“我知道凤凰，凤凰
教我们储存食物。”小
黄雀跳上那棵最高的松
树，向远处望去。

[P7] “以前，鸟儿们每天吃饱了就唱歌、睡觉，只有凤凰从早到晚忙着收果子、采草籽，积攒了满满一山洞食物，去年大旱才能分给鸟儿们吃。现在，妈妈每天带我采果子，我攒的果子已经装满一个树洞了。”小黄雀骄傲地说。
“妈妈，我能带着我的树洞去朝见凤凰吗？”小黄雀问妈妈。
黄雀妈妈啄啄小黄雀的背说：“孩子，树洞不用带，朝见凤凰，我们只需要带上一颗勤劳的心。”

[P8] 清晨，雁群出发的时候，三十只小
黄雀也加入了朝见凤凰的队伍。
晚上，他们歇在一片白桦林里。
白桦林里住着九十九只乌鸦。

[P9] “嗨，你们要到哪里去？”一只小乌鸦问。
小黄雀回答说：“我们要去朝见凤凰。”
“我知道凤凰，凤凰从大火中救了我们。”小乌鸦在白桦林里钻来钻去。

[P10] “从前，我们乌鸦也有漂亮的羽毛，响亮的歌喉。去年森林着火，是凤凰叫来许多鸟儿，把我们从大火中救了出来。虽然大火烧掉了我们的羽毛，熏哑了我们的歌喉，但是，我们还是最聪明的鸟儿！”小乌鸦自豪地说。

“妈妈，去朝见凤凰，我能不能说一个谜语让她猜？”小乌鸦问妈妈。

[P11] 乌鸦妈妈摸摸小乌鸦晃动的脑袋：“当然可以，朝见凤凰，我们要带上一颗快乐的心。”
清晨，雁群和黄雀出发的时候，九十九只乌鸦也加入了朝见凤凰的队伍。
晚上，他们歌在一片竹林里。
竹林里住着五只孔雀。

[P12] “嗨，你们要到哪里去？”一只小孔雀问。
小乌鸦回答说：“我们要去朝见凤凰。”
“我知道凤凰，凤凰还缺一身漂亮的羽衣。”小孔雀在竹林的边缘散着步。

[P13] 清晨，雁群和黄雀、乌鸦出发的时候，五只孔雀也加入了朝见凤凰的队伍。

[P14] 后来，燕子、斑鸠、白头翁、布谷鸟……也加入了这支越来越庞大的队伍。

[P15] 终于，在凤凰生日这一天，所有的鸟儿都来到了丹穴山。

[P16] 每只鸟儿献上自己最美的一根羽毛，编织成一件光彩夺目的羽衣，送给善良、勤劳、勇敢的凤凰做生日礼物，还推举它做了百鸟之王。

[P17] “叽叽”“喳喳”“啾啾”，你听，凤凰正带着鸟儿在天空巡游呢！
full_text_en:
[P1] Children's Reading · Classic Chinese Mythological Stories
A Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix
Adapted by Mao Hongyan, Illustrated by Chen Wei Studio
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P2] Chinese Classic Mythology Picture Book
The Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix
Adapted by Mao Hongyan, Illustrated by Chen Wei Studio
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P3] "This little dried fish, I must take it, it's the most delicious!"
"This big leaf, I must take it, it's the warmest to cover myself with at night."
"This fruit, I must take it, it's my favorite to eat."
Little goose is packing the luggage to bring for the visit to the Phoenix.

[P4] The goose mother smiled and asked him, "Should we bring this clump of reeds?"
"The flowers on this clump of reeds are whiter, lighter, and softer than my feathers—of course we should bring it!" the gosling said with bright eyes. "Last year, there was a great drought. Trees and grass withered and died. Birds were so hungry they couldn't fly. It was the Phoenix who opened its mountain cave and shared fruits and seeds with everyone. This clump of reeds grew from a single seed you treasured. How could we not bring it to pay respects to the Phoenix?"
The goose mother patted the gosling's wing and said, "Child, we don't need to bring the reeds. To pay respects to the Phoenix, we only need to bring a heart full of gratitude!"

[P5] The next day, Little Goose and Mom followed the flock of geese,
 flying toward Danxue Mountain, where the Phoenix lived.
 In the evening, they rested in a pine forest.
 Thirty yellow birds lived in the pine forest.

[P6] The little yellow bird curiously asked the little goose: "Hey, where are you going?"
The little goose replied: "We are going to pay homage to the Phoenix."

"I know the Phoenix. The Phoenix taught us how to store food." The little yellow bird jumped onto the tallest pine tree and looked into the distance.

[P7] "Long ago, birds sang and slept after eating, but only the phoenix worked from morning till night, gathering fruits and seeds, storing a whole mountain cave full of food, which was shared with the birds during last year's drought. Now, Mom takes me to gather fruits every day, and I've filled a tree hollow with what I've saved," the little yellowbird said proudly.
"Mom, can I bring my tree hollow to pay respects to the phoenix?" the little yellowbird asked.
The yellowbird mother pecked her child's back and said, "Child, you don't need to bring the hollow. To pay respects to the phoenix, we only need to bring a hardworking heart."

[P8] In the morning, when the geese set out, thirty little yellow sparrows also joined the procession to pay homage to the Phoenix.
In the evening, they rested in a birch forest.
Ninety-nine crows lived in the birch forest.

[P9] "Hi, where are you going?" asked a little crow.
Little yellowbird answered, "We are going to pay homage to the Phoenix."
"I know the Phoenix. The Phoenix saved us from the fire," said the little crow, darting around in the birch forest.

[P10] "Long ago, we crows had beautiful feathers and loud voices. Last year, when the forest caught fire, it was the Phoenix who called many birds to save us from the flames. Although the fire burned away our feathers and made our voices hoarse, we are still the smartest birds!" the little crow said proudly.

"Mom, when we go to see the Phoenix, can I tell her a riddle to guess?" the little crow asked his mom.

[P11] The crow mother patted her little crow's wiggling head: "Of course you can. When we go to see the Phoenix, we must bring a happy heart." 
In the morning, when the geese and the yellow sparrows set off, ninety-nine crows also joined the procession to see the Phoenix. 
At night, they sang in a bamboo forest. 
Five peacocks lived in the bamboo forest.

[P12] "Hi, where are you going?" asked a little peacock.
The little crow answered, "We are going to pay homage to the Phoenix."
"I know the Phoenix. The Phoenix still lacks a beautiful coat of feathers," said the little peacock, strolling along the edge of the bamboo forest.

[P13] In the morning, as the geese, yellowbirds, and crows set off, five peacocks also joined the procession to pay homage to the Phoenix.

[P14] Later, swallows, turtle doves, white-headed buntings, cuckoos... also joined this ever-growing procession.

[P15] Finally, on the day of the Phoenix's birthday, all the birds arrived at Danxue Mountain.

[P16] Each bird offered its most beautiful feather, weaving them into a dazzling robe, to give as a birthday gift to the kind, hardworking, and brave Phoenix, and also elected it as the King of All Birds.

[P17] "Chirp chirp" "Tweet tweet" "Tweet tweet", listen, the Phoenix is leading the birds on a sky tour!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《百鸟朝凤》的封面，展示了凤凰在众多小鸟环绕中飞翔的场景，标题和作者信息清晰可见。
[P2] 本页为绘本《百鸟朝凤》的封面，展示了凤凰在众多小鸟环绕中飞翔的场景，标题、作者及出版社信息清晰可见。
[P3] 小雁正在为去朝见凤凰准备行李，它挑选了小鱼干、大树叶和果子，并在草地上忙碌地收拾。
[P4] 大雁妈妈和小雁讨论是否要带上芦苇去朝见凤凰，小雁认为芦苇是凤凰当年赐予的草籽种出的，必须带上以示感恩，但妈妈告诉他，最重要的是带上一颗感恩的心。
[P5] 小雁和妈妈跟随雁群飞往凤凰居住的丹穴山，晚上在松树林里休息，那里住着三十只黄雀。
[P6] 小黄雀好奇地询问小雁和雁群的去向，小雁回答他们要去朝见凤凰，小黄雀则表示自己知道凤凰，并提到凤凰曾教它们储存食物。
[P7] 小黄雀向妈妈讲述自己和妈妈每天采果子、攒满树洞的经历，并询问是否能带着树洞去朝见凤凰，妈妈教导它只需带上一颗勤劳的心。
[P8] 雁群和三十只小黄雀一同前往朝见凤凰，晚上在白桦林中休息，那里住着九十九只乌鸦。
[P9] 小乌鸦在白桦林中询问雁群和小黄雀的去向，得知他们要去朝见凤凰，并提到凤凰曾从大火中救过它们。
[P10] 小乌鸦回忆起凤凰曾带领鸟群从森林大火中救出它们，并自豪地表示自己虽失去羽毛和歌喉，但依然聪明。它随后询问妈妈是否可以在朝见凤凰时说一个谜语。
[P11] 乌鸦妈妈鼓励小乌鸦带上快乐的心去朝见凤凰，随后九十九只乌鸦加入队伍，晚上大家在竹林中休息，那里住着五只孔雀。
[P12] 在竹林中，小孔雀询问小乌鸦和雁群的去向，得知他们要去朝见凤凰，并提到凤凰还缺一身漂亮的羽衣。
[P13] 清晨，雁群、黄雀、乌鸦和五只孔雀一同出发，前往朝见凤凰。
[P14] 越来越多的鸟类，如燕子、斑鸠、白头翁和布谷鸟，加入了前往朝见凤凰的队伍，队伍变得越来越庞大。
[P15] 在凤凰生日这一天，来自各地的鸟儿们齐聚丹穴山，准备朝见凤凰。
[P16] 众鸟为凤凰献上各自最美的羽毛，编织成华丽羽衣作为生日礼物，并推举凤凰为百鸟之王。
[P17] 凤凰带领着众多鸟儿在天空中巡游，鸟群围绕在凤凰身边，场面壮观。
[P18] 画面中，一只戴着彩色头巾的鸟儿与一只展开翅膀、嘴里衔着紫色物品的小乌鸦在岩石上相遇，背景为简洁的线条勾勒的地面，整体风格类似邮票边框的插画。
